translations.web: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
translations.bsb: But you, O man of God, flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
translations.kjv: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
